payload.summary: Twenty-one dictionary sources need a date; four AIHW pages block automated reads
payload.detail: After the 2026-09-16 register work, 41 of the 58 dictionary-handover sources remain held and the binding constraint is now a date rather than governance. None of the 41 carries a publication or review date in the handover. Seventeen have a publisher that is now registered and need only a date read from the publisher's own page. Four AIHW pages (alcohol and other drug treatment glossary, suicide and self-harm monitoring glossary, ambulance attendances, opioid agonist therapy in the prisons report) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch; AIHW is registered and ledger-eligible, so a release date is the only thing missing for all four. A WA Health PDF and the national recovery framework also need a browser read. Per-source blockers and next actions are in src/data/dictionary-source-dispositions.json.
